answer: Each epoch, every applicant must complete a live task drawn from a published zenith problem set and record the transcript in ink from a one-use quill whose chemical fingerprint is bound to their address and the epoch seed. A bonded raven courier, assigned by hashing that address with the seed, delivers the transcript to a clerk who may countersign only once. Settlement clusters reused ink fingerprints, shared couriers, or matching transcript-timing skeletons, slashes those deposits, and benches the overlapping couriers for two epochs.
